head: ATTRACTIVE
TO *GIRLS?*
beats.vo: It is actually really easy to tell if you are attractive to girls.

beats.title: FACIAL THIRDS
beats.vo: First, your facial thirds. Hairline to brows, brows to nose, nose to chin. When the three are close to equal, the face reads balanced.
beats.chip: hairline to brows, to nose, to chin

beats.title: HAIR FOR YOUR FACE SHAPE
beats.vo: Second, a haircut that fits your face shape. A long face wants volume at the sides. A round face wants height on top.
beats.chip: volume where your face needs it

beats.title: POSTURE
beats.vo: Third, posture. Chin level, shoulders back, neck straight. It shows all the height you already have.
